key_impacts: PHIVOLCS issued Tsunami Alert Level 3 at 21:01 local time advising immediate evacuation for coastal areas of Northern Samar, Eastern Samar, Leyte, Southern Leyte, Surigao del Norte and Surigao del Sur.
An estimated average of 80% of residents in surveyed coastal barangays evacuated; only one barangay did not follow the evacuation advice.
No significant tsunami wave was observed and no damages were reported; the tsunami alert was cancelled at 00:10 on 1 September 2012.
Warning dissemination was delayed in several areas; in parts of Guiuan the warning arrived after the expected tsunami arrival window (~10 minutes travel time).
Communication issues occurred during the alert, including mobile network problems, major power cuts, and a radio station broadcasting wrong information in one municipality.
missing_information: Exact evacuee counts by locality not provided; damages explicitly reported as none.
